# Deep Cuts: Music Trivia

> Deep Cuts is a music trivia app for iPhone: classic rock, Southern rock, metal, Motown and more, with Name That Tune, covers and the story behind every answer.

## App

- [Music Trivia App for Rock Fans | Deep Cuts: Music Trivia](https://jackwallner.com/ios/deepcuts/index.html.md): Deep Cuts is a music trivia app for iPhone: classic rock, Southern rock, metal, Motown and more, with Name That Tune, covers and the story behind every answer.
